purpose: Prepare privacy-preserving passive observation of gaze state and interaction context without screen mutation.

activities.label: verify minimal passive trace and privacy boundary

queries.question: Can VIZZ observe gaze quality and interaction context without persisting text, key identity, video or screen content?

assumptions: The GazeState provider is external to this privacy adapter.
Keyboard activity is represented only by count and recency.
Mouse coordinates are contextual and never establish gaze truth.
kill_tests: The trace must reject or avoid key identity, text, video, window title and screen content.
The observer must not start camera or mutate display content in this phase.
unknowns: Whether real-time Windows capture can supply the contract without privacy leakage.
How much passive data is needed for an A/B task comparison.
Whether keyboard activity improves task-state classification without contaminating gaze inference.
